lines.en: You know, I know my life's going pretty well,
but I look around and I just see so many people
who've accomplished so many of their goals
Yeah, but you shouldn't compare yourself to me.
Come on, come on, baby, do it, baby!
Come on, baby! Come on, baby, come on!
That's everything I wanted to do before I was 30.
Oh, except I wanted to patch things up with my sister.
And, and girls, this thing is a godsend,
if you know what I mean.
